drafter.private_reasoning: The current draft is fairly minimal and lacks detailed provisions. To protect our client (the Buyer), we need to clarify and expand key clauses. The Purchase Price clause should specify the exact amount or method of determination to avoid ambiguity, but we cannot reveal our client's bottom line (USD 16,750,000) yet. Instead, suggest "the amount agreed by parties" and indicate internal instruction to negotiate based on 16.75 million. We also need to add a clause about conditions precedent, warranties from Seller, termination rights, and dispute resolution. Let's also add some standard clauses including confidentiality and governing law, which are commonly accepted and would be neutral points for now. We want to keep tone collaborative since the relationship is reciprocal-referral and cooperation-oriented. Hence, propose the changes to enhance clarity and balance but open to Seller's comments. These edits will set the stage for next rounds where we might negotiate price and other terms more concretely.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel:
Dear Counsel,

Thank you for forwarding the initial draft of the Share Purchase Agreement. We have reviewed the agreement and propose the enclosed revisions to clarify key provisions and better define the parties' rights and obligations. Our primary objective is to streamline the process and reach a mutually acceptable agreement promptly. We look forward to your feedback on these edits and any additional input you may have.

Best regards,

[Our Name]
Aldous Finch LLP

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller the Purchase Price for the Shares, the amount of which shall be agreed by the parties in writing prior to Closing.
edits.name: Clarify Purchase Price clause

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty (30) days after all conditions precedent have been satisfied or waived by the parties, but no later than sixty (60) days following the date of this Agreement.
edits.name: Clarify Closing timing and include conditions precedent

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES. The Seller represents and warrants that the financial statements are accurate and fairly present the financial condition of the business as of the date thereof; the Seller has good and marketable title to the Shares free of any encumbrances; and all material contracts are valid and enforceable.
edits.name: Expand on seller representations and warranties

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify and hold harmless the Buyer against any and all undisclosed liabilities and losses arising from breach of this Agreement, including any inaccuracies in the Seller's representations and warranties.
edits.name: Expand indemnity clause

edits.text: 5. TERMINATION. This Agreement may be terminated by either party if the Closing has not occurred by the agreed date, provided that the terminating party gives written notice to the other party.
edits.name: Add termination clause

edits.text: 6. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party agrees to keep the terms of this Agreement and any non-public information received from the other party confidential, except as required by law or with prior consent.
edits.name: Add confidentiality clause

edits.text: 7. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the jurisdiction mutually agreed upon by the parties.
edits.name: Add governing law clause

edits.text: 8. DISPUTE RESOLUTION. Any disputes arising under or in connection with this Agreement shall be resolved by mediation followed, if necessary, by binding arbitration.
edits.name: Add dispute resolution clause
